name: io.github.recomention/mcp
title: recomention
description: Check whether AI engines recommend a product: public AI rankings and recomention reports.

environmentVariables.name: RECOMENTION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from your recomention account (Developers). Needed for reports; public rankings and suggested questions work without it.

environmentVariables.name: RECOMENTION_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin. Must be https:// (http:// only for localhost).

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own OpenAI key, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Anthropic key, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Perplexity key, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Gemini key, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).

environmentVariables.name: XAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own xAI (Grok) key, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. DataForSEO login:password for Google AI Overview, used only for reports started with funding "byok" (needs an active Agent plan).
